title: Keyword-seeded register shifts
question: Do the archived ten page keywords, register lengths and tap patterns produce a source-reported candidate?
reader_question: Could an archived keyword seed a feedback shift register that decrypts these pages?
summary: None of 400 source settings on LP2-04–13 passed the program’s normalized coincidence cutoff; a complete known-reading plant passed and recovered exactly.
finding: The exact source grid is 10 pages × 5 register lengths × 4 tap lists × 2 subtraction directions. The highest manuscript normalized 29×IoC was 1.097, below the source reporting gate of greater than 1.20. Zero of 199 complete page-shuffle searches passed the same gate. The first-koan plant recovered 209 of 209 runes and ranked first across 400 cases.
limitations: A gated non-result is not a significance test or a general exclusion of feedback ciphers. The source gate and English-substring score were calibrated only by one clean 209-rune plant. This covers the ten fixed keywords, four specified tap lists, lengths 4–8, two directions and uninterrupted page-local clocks; other states, clocks, encodings and layers remain untested.
next_steps: For a distinct register proposal, specify seed, taps, clock and transform before reading output; require complete known-message recovery and an untouched manuscript check.

scope.representation: Exact committed Wulfic rune files for old pages 21–30, matched rune for rune to current LP2-04–13.
scope.procedure: Replay the source keyword-seeded LFSR, strict normalized-IoC reporting gate, complete planted known-reading search, and 199 whole-grid page-shuffle controls.
scope.parameters: 400 source settings, 396 distinct manuscript decoded outputs, 199 complete page-shuffle searches.
scope.exclusions: Other states/taps, other pages, interruption or reset rules, layered ciphers and alternate score gates.

review.kind: bounded source-function replay with full-message recovery gate
review.reviewer: Exact pinned source function; independent 400-case arithmetic, source/site parity and full-grid controls

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library plus exact public Wulfic Git checkout at bf89d3d13aad2b8f2c95ab195cf1b092f250775c; original unlicensed source read by SHA-256-verified Git blob, not bundled.

visuals.caption: Best coincidence per page versus the source reporting gate; the full known-reading control cleared it.

reader_finding: None of the 400 tested keyword-seeded register settings produced an output that passed the program’s language screen. The search did recover a complete 209-rune known message under one of those settings.
reader_limit: This covers the ten fixed keywords and specified register rules on LP2-04–13. Passing the screen would not by itself establish a reading, and other feedback rules remain open.
